meta.name: prisma-postgres-setup
meta.description: Set up a new Prisma Postgres database and connect it to a local project using the Management API. Use when asked to "set up a database", "create a Prisma Postgres project", "get a connection string", "connect my app to Prisma Postgres", or "provision a database".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 开通数据库并接入本地项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在本地项目中快速接入一个 Postgres 数据库。
copy.tagline_en: Set up a Postgres database for your local project.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a Postgres database connected to your local project quickly.

howto.what: 它会引导你新建一个 Prisma Postgres 云数据库,完成身份验证、选择部署区域、创建项目并获取连接字符串;然后在本地项目安装依赖、写入配置、配置数据模型,最后运行脚本确认连接成功。
howto.when: 当你说出“set up a database”“get a connection string”“provision a database”等与创建数据库相关的请求时触发。

say.text: 帮我设置一个 Prisma Postgres 数据库
say.note: Claude 会开始按流程创建数据库。

say.text: 创建 Prisma Postgres 项目并连接到本地
say.note: 会引导选择区域并获取连接串。

say.text: 获取 Prisma Postgres 的连接字符串
say.note: 会创建项目并给出直连字符串。

howto.what_en: Guides you through creating a Prisma Postgres database via the Management API and connecting it to a local project. Handles auth, region selection, project creation, connection string extraction, local config, schema setup, and a verification script.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to set up a database, create a Prisma Postgres project, get a connection string, or provision a database.

say_en.text: Set up a Prisma Postgres database for me
say_en.note: Claude will start the provisioning workflow.

say_en.text: Create a Prisma Postgres project and connect it locally
say_en.note: You'll pick a region and get a connection string.

say_en.text: Get me a Prisma Postgres connection string
say_en.note: Claude creates a project and returns the direct string.
